name: The Yarrow
suitableFor: Couples and groups wanting a hotel with a spa in Broadstairs
confirmedFeatures: Restaurant, bar, spa, hair and beauty salon
overview: The Yarrow is a hotel on Ramsgate Road in Broadstairs, a short drive from Joss Bay. It has a restaurant serving lunch and dinner on set days, a bar menu through the week, and an on-site spa with a hair and beauty salon, so there is somewhere to eat and recover without going back out.
surfTripFit: A comfortable hotel base in Broadstairs within a short drive of Joss Bay, with a spa for after cold-water sessions.
